{
  "findings": [
    {
      "page": 351,
      "where": "Corollary 3.2, item (i)",
      "scan": "C est stable par produits fibrés",
      "tex": "$C$ est stables par produits fibrés",
      "kind": "word",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "$C$ est stables",
        "new": "$C$ est stable"
      },
      "note": "The print has singular « stable »."
    },
    {
      "page": 352,
      "where": "Footnote (1), first sentence",
      "scan": "pour l'existence de u*",
      "tex": "pour l'existence se\n$u^{\\ast}$",
      "kind": "word",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "l'existence se",
        "new": "l'existence de"
      },
      "note": "The print reads « de », not « se »."
    },
    {
      "page": 352,
      "where": "Footnote (1), reference after « les formules »",
      "scan": "les formules 4.1 (i)",
      "tex": "\\hyperref[VII.prop4.1]{4.1} (i)",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "\\hyperref[VII.prop4.1]{4.1} (ii)",
      "note": "The cohomology formulas are in 4.1 (ii). The TeX keeps the printed wrong reference."
    },
    {
      "page": 352,
      "where": "Footnote (1), last sentence",
      "scan": "remplacer (Sch)_{/X}",
      "tex": "remplaces $(\\Sch)_{/X}$",
      "kind": "word",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "remplaces",
        "new": "remplacer"
      },
      "note": "The print has the infinitive « remplacer »."
    },
    {
      "page": 352,
      "where": "Proposition 4.1, item (ii), parenthetical explanation",
      "scan": "de la suite spectrale de Leray",
      "tex": "de la suite spectrales de Leray",
      "kind": "word",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "suite spectrales de Leray",
        "new": "suite spectrale de Leray"
      },
      "note": "The print has singular « spectrale »."
    },
    {
      "page": 352,
      "where": "Proposition 4.1, item (ii), after « Leray »",
      "scan": "(définis par exemple comme edge-homomorphismes de la suite spectrale de Leray suivants",
      "tex": "(définis par\nexemple comme edge-homomorphismes de la suite spectrales de Leray\nsuivants",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "(définis par exemple comme edge-homomorphismes de la suite spectrale de Leray) suivants",
      "note": "The print omits the closing parenthesis after « Leray ». The TeX keeps that omission; its extra s in « spectrales » is a separate transcription error."
    },
    {
      "page": 353,
      "where": "Proposition 4.1, second displayed cohomology isomorphism",
      "scan": "H^{\\ast}(X_{\\text{ét}},G) \\xrightarrow{\\sim} H^{\\ast}((\\Sch)_{/X},u^{\\ast}(G))",
      "tex": "H^{\\ast} (X_{\\text{\\rm ét}}, F \\circ u) \\xrightarrow{\\sim} H^{\\ast}((\\Sch)_{/X}, F){\\quoi}.",
      "kind": "formula",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "H^{\\ast} (X_{\\text{\\rm ét}}, F \\circ u) \\xrightarrow{\\sim} H^{\\ast}((\\Sch)_{/X}, F){\\quoi}.",
        "new": "H^{\\ast} (X_{\\text{\\rm ét}}, G) \\xrightarrow{\\sim} H^{\\ast}((\\Sch)_{/X}, u^{\\ast} (G)){\\quoi}."
      },
      "note": "The TeX duplicates the first formula. The printed second formula has G on the left and u^{\\ast}(G) on the right."
    },
    {
      "page": 353,
      "where": "Paragraph beginning « Ainsi »",
      "scan": "Ainsi, (i) montre",
      "tex": "Ainsi, (i) montre",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "medium",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "Ainsi, (ii) montre",
      "note": "The cohomological comparison just stated belongs to 4.1 (ii), not (i). The TeX keeps the printed reference."
    },
    {
      "page": 353,
      "where": "Section 4.2, name of the fpqc topology",
      "scan": "fidèlement plate quasi-compacte",
      "tex": "fidèlement plat quasi-compacte",
      "kind": "word",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "fidèlement plat quasi-compacte",
        "new": "fidèlement plate quasi-compacte"
      },
      "note": "The print has « plate », agreeing with « topologie »."
    },
    {
      "page": 353,
      "where": "Section 4.2.1, after the reference to SGA 3",
      "scan": "(ou une topologie, telle fppf, envisagée dans SGA 3, les groupes",
      "tex": "(ou une topologie, telle\nfppf, envisagée dans \\SGA 3, les  groupes",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "(ou une topologie, telle fppf, envisagée dans \\SGA 3), les groupes",
      "note": "The print leaves the parenthesis beginning « ou une topologie » unclosed. The TeX keeps the omission."
    },
    {
      "page": 354,
      "where": "Section 4.2.2, introduction of f_*",
      "scan": "image directe",
      "tex": "image directs",
      "kind": "word",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "image directs",
        "new": "image directe"
      },
      "note": "The print reads « image directe »."
    },
    {
      "page": 354,
      "where": "Footnote (*), title of the cited book",
      "scan": "in \"Dix exposés sur la topologie des schémas, North Holland Pub. Cie.",
      "tex": "« Dix exposés sur la topologie des schémas », North Holland Pub.",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "« Dix exposés sur la topologie des schémas », North Holland Pub. Cie.",
      "note": "The print omits the closing quotation mark delimiting the book title. The TeX silently supplies it after « schémas »."
    },
    {
      "page": 355,
      "where": "Paragraph before Proposition 4.3",
      "scan": "des faisceaux de coefficients F tel que",
      "tex": "des faisceaux de coefficients $F$ tel\nque",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "des faisceaux de coefficients $F$ tels que",
      "note": "The print has singular « tel » where plural « tels » is required. The TeX keeps the printed misprint."
    },
    {
      "page": 355,
      "where": "Proof of Proposition 4.3, first cohomology expression",
      "scan": "H^{\\ast}(X_{\\Zar}, f_{\\ast}(F_{\\text{ét}}))",
      "tex": "H^{\\ast} (X_{\\Zar'}\nf_{\\ast} (F_{\\text{ét}}))",
      "kind": "formula",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "X_{\\Zar'}",
        "new": "X_{\\Zar},"
      },
      "note": "The printed comma separating the arguments has become a prime inside the subscript in the TeX."
    }
  ],
  "coordinator": "351: 1/0; 352: 3/2; 353: 2/2; 354: 1/1; 355: 1/1 (normal/misprint)."
}
